name: The Workstation (browser UI for Claude Code)
description: Installs The Workstation web UI for Claude Code, optionally the Claude Code CLI, and autostarts the server on container start.

source.description: Where to get The Workstation. git: clone sourceUrl at 'version' and build. npm: npm i -g the package named by sourceUrl (default 'workstation') at 'version'. tarball: download a source tarball (e.g. a GitHub archive or release asset) from sourceUrl and build. local: use a bind-mounted checkout at localPath (built on first start if needed).

version.description: Git ref (branch/tag/sha) for source=git, or npm version/dist-tag for source=npm ('latest' is used if you pass 'main' with npm). Ignored for tarball/local.

sourceUrl.description: git: repo URL (default https://github.com/OWNER/the-workstation.git). npm: package name (default 'workstation'). tarball: tarball URL (required).

localPath.description: source=local only: absolute path inside the container where the checkout is mounted.

host.description: Bind address. 0.0.0.0 is needed so the forwarded port reaches the server; access is still token-gated.

autostart.description: Start the server in the background on every container start and print the tokenized URL.

installClaudeCode.description: Also install the Claude Code CLI (@anthropic-ai/claude-code) globally. The Agent SDK ships its own runtime; this is for terminal use and 'claude login'.

nodeVersion.description: Node.js major version to install if Node >= 20 is not already present.
